usage: xo get [--dir=<dir>] [--json] [-u] [--accept-effects] <module path>[@version|@latest|@none]...

Require a module (decision 0086): the latest vX.Y.Z tag unless a
version is given; @none removes the requirement; -u alone upgrades
every requirement. Fetches with git into the module cache ($XO_MODCACHE
or <user cache dir>/xo/mod), resolves the graph by minimal version
selection, rewrites xo.mod and xo.lock, and prints the API and effect
changes of every version change. --accept-effects records the new
version's effects in xo.lock even when they are wider than the locked
ones (else XO1317, nothing written).
